title: feat(cli): add OpenClaw harness to polli CLI
author: Marcus-Mok-GH
pr_body_excerpt:
Addresses #14121. Adds the OpenClaw harness to the shared `polli harness` workflow built on the foundation from #14107, using the existing `apps/openclaw` integration as reference.

## What this adds

`polli harness openclaw on|off|status`.

### Quest requirements, met minimally

- **New or existing installs** — `on` merges a `pollinations` provider into `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` (honors `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH` / `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, tilde included). It works from scratch or on an existing config the same way, with no subprocess onboarding to simulate.
- **Missing OpenClaw → official install offered** — `on` refuses before any login/key/config work with `https://openclaw.ai/install`.
- **Dedicated key** — shared `resolveHarnessKey` mints `polli-harness-openclaw`; a still-valid stored key is reused. Stored once in `env.vars.POLLI_OPENCLAW_API_KEY`, referenced from the provider as `${POLLI_OPENCLAW_API_KEY}` (OpenClaw's documented substitution), so the secret never appears twice.
- **No second hardcoded catalog** — models come from `fetchHarnessModels()` (live `gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models`, tool-calling text only), the same helper as the other adapters.
- **Selectable default** — `--model <id>`, validated against the live catalog, default `kimi`; written to `agents.defaults.model.primary`.
- **Polli skill** — installed as a managed skill at `<state-dir>/skills/polli/SKILL.md` for image/audio/video generation.
- **Works with current OpenClaw** — schema matches `docs/concepts/model-providers.md` (`models.providers.<id>`, `models.mode` only set if unset, `env.vars` + `${VAR}`).
- **Unrelated config preserved** — only the config file and skill are ever written; an explicit existing `models.mode` (e.g. `"replace"`) is never overridden; atomic writes with 0600 permissions.
- **`status`** — reports configured/not and the active default model.
- **`off` removes only Pollinations-owned changes** — byte-for-byte snapshot restore when the files are untouched; otherwise surgi

gist.headline: Polli joins the claw
gist.blurb: The polli CLI can now tuck Pollinations into OpenClaw with one small command. A dedicated key, a live model menu, and a tiny managed skill arrive without trampling the rest of your config garden.
gist.summary: Added `polli harness openclaw on|off|status`, which configures an OpenClaw `pollinations` provider with a dedicated reusable `polli-harness-openclaw` key, live tool-calling model catalog, selectable `--model` default (defaulting to `kimi`), and a managed Polli media-generation skill.
gist.impact: OpenClaw users can enable Pollinations from the CLI while preserving unrelated configuration and existing `models.mode`, then inspect the active model or cleanly remove Pollinations-owned setup with `status` and `off`.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli helping a friendly OpenClaw-inspired pixel crab/assistant connect a cozy CRT terminal to a Pollinations garden. The terminal shows a simple `polli harness openclaw on` command and a model selector, while a locked jar labeled as an API key is safely stored beside sprouting code-plants; Polli wears a tiny mechanic tool belt to show careful configuration rather than chaotic setup.
